about: Inputs for continuouspricing.html. One invented economy cabin on one flight, sold over a 180-day booking period. Every fare, demand figure and willingness-to-pay parameter is an illustrative assumption, not any airline's data. Fares are one-way, in US dollars, on the same $130 to $620 range as bookinglimits.html and buydown.html.

arrivals.shape: exponential booking curve: shoppers per day proportional to exp(-t / scaleDays), t = days before departure
